page_title: MON 1-1 LEN | Monaco v Lens 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+6' Breel Embolo (Monaco) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
90+3' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Philipp Kohn no chance!
90+3' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+3' Referee Willy Delajod awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+2' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Lens, he's going to review using VAR.
90+1' Surely that's handball by one of the Monaco players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

88' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
88' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lens.
87' An attempted cross from David Pereira da Costa (Lens) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
87' Lens have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
86' Jhoanner Chavez will be replaced by Martin Satriano (Lens).
84' 1 - 0 A perfectly taken corner kick. Denis Zakaria (Monaco) produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the top left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:0.
84' The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.
82' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lens due to a foul in the build-up play.
82' The Lens players halt their celebrations as referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) will replace Christian Mawissa Elebi.
81' Referee Willy Delajod halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Will Still, then shows him a yellow.

79' Hamzat Ojediran produces a sweet pass and picks out Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:1!
78' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Caio Henrique (Monaco), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
77' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
73' A cross from a corner kick by Lens is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.

72' Florian Sotoca (Lens) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
71' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
68' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
66' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Caio Henrique (Monaco) replacing Kassoum Ouattara.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eliesse Ben Seghir trots off the pitch and is replaced by George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
65' Substitution. Breel Embolo (Monaco) replaces Folarin Balogun.
65' Will Still prepares a substitution. Ruben Aguilar is replaced by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) for Adrien Thomasson.
63' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

62' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

61' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper. The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
60' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
58' Florian Sotoca (Lens) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn makes a comfortable save.
57' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
56' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul. Monaco earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
55' The linesman signals that Florian Sotoca (Lens) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
54' Vanderson (Monaco) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
54' A quickly taken corner by Monaco.
54' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
49' A rebound falls kindly for Florian Sotoca (Lens), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
48' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
47' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' Half-time substitution. Wesley Said (Lens) will not participate anymore and Remy Labeau Lascary is coming on.
46' Adi Hutter makes a half-time substitution. Vanderson comes on in place of Jordan Teze (Monaco).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' What a poor attempt! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
45+2' Poor challenge! Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) is penalised for tripping and Willy Delajod blows his whistle.
45+1' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Monaco are ruled offside.
44' Monaco take a short corner kick.

44' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
42' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

42' Takumi Minamino has a look up and finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post. It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
41' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Philipp Kohn comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' A substitution has been made. Anass Zaroury is replaced by David Pereira da Costa (Lens).
39' What was Florian Sotoca (Lens) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
38' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) tries to find Maghnes Akliouche, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
35' Anass Zaroury (Lens) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
35' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
34' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make. Monaco are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
31' Wesley Said (Lens) fires a rebound from close range onto the bar!
31' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
31' Monaco control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

28' Wesley Said (Lens) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
28' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) sends a cross in and finds Maghnes Akliouche inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
26' Half-chance! Ruben Aguilar (Lens) plays a pass into the box, but Philipp Kohn reacts well to snuff out the attack.
24' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
23' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) sends a long ball forward to Folarin Balogun, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
22' Flag up against Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
21' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lens, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Jordan Teze (Monaco) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Willy Delajod signals. A free kick is awarded to Lens.
17' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
17' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
14' Lens fail to score from a corner as Philipp Kohn (Monaco) leaps to collect the ball.
14' A long ball forward to Wesley Said (Lens) is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lens are going to take it.
13' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to find Folarin Balogun, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lens, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Jordan Teze (Monaco) tackles a bit over-zealously and Willy Delajod blows for a foul. Lens earn a free kick.

10' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
9' Monaco have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
9' That's a clear yellow card. Jonathan Gradit (Lens) goes into the book.
8' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.

5' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) receives a reproachful look from Denis Zakaria. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.

4' That didn't go as planned! Florian Sotoca (Lens) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Philipp Kohn, who easily kept it out.
3' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared. Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
2' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. Lens force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.

1' Anass Zaroury (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monaco will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
